questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg havde hørt at det var en god by og et fedt universitet.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det har været ret nemt.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg synes vi har fået mange mails og oplæg fra host universitet, de har gjort et godt stykke arbejde.

How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Vi fandt noget privat, ved derfor ikke noget om kollegier, studieboliger osv.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Opmærksom på transport til og fra uni.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg ved det ikke, har fundet noget privat.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Der var problemer med deres system, og det var derfor ret besværligt.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Man går ind i deres kursuskatalog, finder de kruser man godt kunne tænke sig, og melder sig til. Man skal være obs. på tidspunkter osv.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Alle undervisere og fagledere stod listet, det var derfor nemt at finde frem til div. mailadresser hvis man havde problemer.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Fik alle de kurser jeg godt kunne tænke mig, så det gik godt.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Tag den med ro, selv hvis du ikke får plads via heico, kan man altid møde op til timen og tage en snak med underviseren og så skal de nok finde en plads, for der er altid nogen der springer fra.

Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Jeg synes at niveauet har været godt, meget det samme som jeg er vant til.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Man skal klart vænne sig til deres struktur, men de er gode til at forklare hvad de forventer og forestiller sig.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.answer:
Aktuelle Forschungsfragen im Bereich Mehrsprachigkeit und Sprachkontaktlinguistik 
Mehrsprachigkeit und Identität 
Technologie und sprachliche Interaktion 
„Hallo Schatz, wie schön, dich hier zu sehen!“ Anrede mit Namen in der Interaktion

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg ved ikke om jeg kan anbefale noget som sådan, det vigtigste er bare at man virkelig vælger noget man har interesse i, så går det altid lidt lettere. Alle undervisere jeg har mødt har været enormt imødekommende, så man skal bare gøre sit bedste.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det var nemt.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Tag initativet og ikke være bange

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Bureaukratiet skal man lige vænne sig til, den distance man har til undervisere her, er ikke det samme som i DK

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: At folk var nemme at komme ind på.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Udnyt de mange fede studiepladser og biblioteker fordelt rundt i byen. Deltag i alle deres arrangementer og meld dig til unisport!

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Orienter dig ordenligt i deres programmer, de kan godt være forvirrende til at starte med.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: alle de venner jeg har fået.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At være væk hjemmefra.

questions.answer: Yes
